description: Expand admin-panel navigation from current 5 routes (Dashboard, Drivers, Passengers, Trips, Settings) to comprehensive 12-section sidebar matching industry standards: Overview, Users, Drivers, Fleet, Trips, Finance, Pricing, Promotions, Analytics, Support, Staff & Roles, Settings. Currently has basic sidebar with Dashboard/Drivers/Passengers/Trips/Settings. All new pages will be scaffolds with proper layout, title, and placeholder content ready for future implementation.
steps: Read apps/admin-panel/src/App.tsx and apps/admin-panel/src/components/Layout.tsx to understand current routing and sidebar structure

Update apps/admin-panel/src/components/Layout.tsx NAV_ITEMS array to include 12 items: Overview (📊 /), Users (👤 /users), Drivers (🚗 /drivers), Fleet (🚙 /fleet), Trips (📍 /trips), Finance (💰 /finance), Pricing (💵 /pricing), Promotions (🎁 /promotions), Analytics (📈 /analytics), Support (💬 /support), Staff & Roles (👥 /staff), Settings (⚙️ /settings)
Rename existing 'Dashboard' to 'Overview' in Layout.tsx and update labelKey to 'nav_overview'
Rename existing 'Passengers' to 'Users' in Layout.tsx and update route to /users, labelKey to 'nav_users'
Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Users.tsx by renaming Passengers.tsx content (same passenger management functionality, just relabeled)

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Fleet.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Fleet Management', subtitle 'Manage vehicles and fleet operations', and placeholder table headers: Plate Number, Vehicle Type, Assigned Driver, Mileage, Last Maintenance, Status, Actions

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Finance.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Finance', subtitle 'Revenue, payouts, and financial reports', and placeholder sections: Total Revenue, Platform Fees, Driver Payouts, Pending Settlements, Recent Transactions table

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Pricing.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Pricing & Fare Management', subtitle 'Configure dynamic pricing and fare rules', and placeholder sections: Base Fare, Per KM Rate, Per Minute Rate, Surge Pricing Rules, Vehicle Type Multipliers

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Promotions.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Promotions', subtitle 'Manage promo codes and campaigns', and placeholder table: Promo Code, Discount, Valid From, Valid To, Usage Count, Status, Actions

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Analytics.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Analytics', subtitle 'Business intelligence and insights', and placeholder chart sections: Trips Over Time, Revenue Trends, Driver Performance, User Acquisition, Peak Hours Heatmap

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/Support.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Support Tickets', subtitle 'Customer support and help desk', and placeholder table: Ticket ID, User, Subject, Status, Priority, Created, Assigned To, Actions

Create apps/admin-panel/src/pages/StaffRoles.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Staff & Roles', subtitle 'Manage admin users and permissions', and placeholder table: Name, Email, Role, Permissions, Last Login, Status, Actions

Update apps/admin-panel/src/App.tsx router children array to include all 12 routes: /, /users, /drivers, /fleet, /trips, /finance, /pricing, /promotions, /analytics, /support, /staff, /settings. Import and wire all new page components

Update apps/admin-panel/src/i18n.ts resources to add translation keys: nav_overview, nav_users, nav_fleet, nav_finance, nav_pricing, nav_promotions, nav_analytics, nav_support, nav_staff, fleet_title, fleet_subtitle, finance_title, finance_subtitle, pricing_title, pricing_subtitle, promotions_title, promotions_subtitle, analytics_title, analytics_subtitle, support_title, support_subtitle, staff_title, staff_subtitle. Include both English and Swahili translations
Verify sidebar scrollability if 12 items overflow viewport height (Layout.tsx nav section already has overflowY: auto)
acceptance_criteria: Admin panel sidebar displays 12 navigation items: Overview, Users, Drivers, Fleet, Trips, Finance, Pricing, Promotions, Analytics, Support, Staff & Roles, Settings
All 12 routes are accessible and display the correct page component
Existing pages (Dashboard→Overview, Passengers→Users, Drivers, Trips, Settings) retain full functionality
New pages (Fleet, Finance, Pricing, Promotions, Analytics, Support, Staff & Roles) display with proper title, subtitle, and placeholder content structure
Sidebar highlights the active route correctly for all 12 items
i18n works for all navigation labels in both English and Swahili
Sidebar scrolls if navigation items exceed viewport height
Login and authentication flow remains unchanged
verification: Run: cd apps/admin-panel && npm run dev
Open browser to http://localhost:5173 (or assigned port)
Verify sidebar displays 12 navigation items in correct order
Click each navigation item and verify correct page loads with title and subtitle
Verify Overview page (formerly Dashboard) shows dashboard content
Verify Users page (formerly Passengers) shows user management table
Verify Drivers page shows driver management table unchanged
Verify Fleet page displays with title 'Fleet Management' and placeholder table structure
Verify Finance page displays with title 'Finance' and placeholder sections
Verify Pricing page displays with title 'Pricing & Fare Management' and placeholder sections
Verify Promotions page displays with title 'Promotions' and placeholder table
Verify Analytics page displays with title 'Analytics' and placeholder chart sections
Verify Support page displays with title 'Support Tickets' and placeholder table
Verify Staff & Roles page displays with title 'Staff & Roles' and placeholder table
Change language (if language switcher exists) and verify all nav labels translate correctly
Resize browser window to small height and verify sidebar scrolls
